name: canvas-ddl
description: Query Canvas and validated trusted course documents for deadlines with source-aware reconciliation.

interface.shortDescription: Query verified Canvas and course-document deadlines
interface.longDescription: Combines live Canvas records with pre-ingested, validated trusted course documents, reconciles conflicts, and returns deadline counts with provenance and completeness status.
defaultPrompt: Use $canvas-ddl to show my deadlines for next week.
Use $canvas-ddl to find which courses have midterm exams.
